title: Relational Soft-Delete Cascading Engine
description: Build a soft-delete engine that cascades deleted_at timestamps to related child models within a transaction.
derived_requirements: Set deleted_at within single atomic database transaction
Exclude soft-deleted children from default ORM query filters
Support selective hard-delete purge for GDPR compliance

required_behavior: Atomically cascade deletion timestamp across parent and foreign-key children
Filter out deleted entities in relational joins
forbidden_behavior: Leaving orphaned active child records when parent is soft-deleted
Physically dropping rows on soft-delete call

failure_taxonomy.description: Parent soft-deleted but children remain active in child queries.

ground_truth_rationale: Enterprise ORMs require atomic soft-delete cascading to maintain relational consistency.
